note: Within Lineage-negative parent, split by CD14. Lin_neg_CD14pos: lineage-negative monocytes — cluster at the lower-right (CD14+, Lineage low/negative). Lin_neg_CD14neg: lineage-negative non-monocytes — cluster at the lower-left (CD14-, Lineage low/negative); feeds the DC branch downstream. The Lineage-positive band at the top is excluded.
tips: Separate monocytes from the DC/NK candidate pool, while excluding T/B cells via the Lineage dump channel. Lin_neg_CD14pos: Lineage below the dump-channel high-cut, CD14+ (i.e., not strictly Lineage-negative; the Lineage dump uses a high-threshold to exclude T/B cells, so events below that cut are kept regardless of absolute level). Lin_neg_CD14neg: Lineage below high-cut, CD14-. Lineage-high events (T, B cells that passed the scatter pre-gate) are excluded because they are not targets of this panel. Useful co-markers: HLA-DR would provide positive confirmation of APC identity and is used downstream at Step 4.
